scope: Three-project English OCR quality comparison over a deterministic five-page slice of the official FUNSD noisy scanned-form test set, plus one current ImagePlugin runtime/finalizer projection.

source.dataset: FUNSD: A Dataset for Form Understanding in Noisy Scanned Documents
source.selection_rule_fixed_before_execution: first five non-AppleDouble PNG files from testing_data/images in lexicographic filename order
source_characteristics: real forms sampled from RVL-CDIP/Truth Tobacco Industry Documents
noise from repeated scanning and printing
word-level human annotations with bounding boxes

execution_contract.docwen_ref_tk_entry: Production docwen.utils.ocr_utils.extract_text_simple with benchmark-only configured-language injection returning english.
execution_contract.docwen_ref_pyside6_entry: Production docwen.utils.ocr_utils.extract_text_simple with benchmark-only configured-language injection returning english.

quality_metric_contract.normalization: Unicode NFKC plus casefold; exact-token metrics split on Unicode alphanumeric runs, while character metrics compare alphanumeric character multisets to avoid treating form reading-order differences as recognition loss.
quality_metric_contract.threshold_purpose: Minimum useful text-reachability gate for noisy scans; not a layout, reading-order, handwriting, or general OCR accuracy claim.

current_only_regression_fixed.description: Both reference extractors explicitly discard confidence scores at or below 0.5; current accepted every parseable result item, allowing low-confidence noise from custom or legacy engines to leak into every OCR-consuming plugin.
current_only_regression_fixed.red_result: current emitted box at threshold, legacy low and legacy unknown in addition to trusted lines
current_only_regression_fixed.post_fix_policy: numeric confidence must be greater than 0.5 for both box/text/score and legacy text/score shapes; numeric strings are accepted and unknown or non-finite NaN scores are rejected

current_runtime_projection.entry: ImagePlugin -> TaskManager -> OutputFinalizer with image_mode=file, OCR enabled, image_md placement and english/en_US
invalid_harness_attempts_excluded: A first route probe used concrete FileRef.format=png instead of the Image plugin category route format=image and was rejected before plugin execution with no artifacts.
A subsequent valid conversion omitted FileRef.size_bytes, so its finalizer input-byte observation was zero; the artifacts were deleted and the canonical rerun supplied the real 111080-byte size.

known_limits: Five English FUNSD pages are a focused noisy-form slice, not the full 50-page test set or a broad business corpus.
Character-multiset F1 and exact-token multiset metrics measure text reachability, not reading order, bounding-box accuracy, layout reconstruction or field relationships.

The slice does not establish handwriting quality, Chinese or other configured-language real-world quality, photo/perspective/illumination robustness, scanned-PDF breadth, packaged-binary quality or performance thresholds.
GOLDEN-004 and overall final artifact parity remain NOT PASSED YET.
